source_title: Agent Skills Can Be Harmful: An Empirical Study of Skill-Induced Failures in LLM Agents
audit_scope: Determine whether the frozen C02 falsifier can obtain author/manual IRF-versus-RRO truth joined to the paper-run task and loaded-skill identities without inferring labels locally.

manual_truth_confirmation.assignment_process: After refinement, the authors manually inspect each remaining case, assign one root-cause label, and finalize labels through group consensus.
manual_truth_confirmation.skilltriage_truth_role: SkillTriage is evaluated against manually assigned labels; it is not used to create the taxonomy or replace manual validation.

paper_run_identity.paired_design: The task instruction, repository/container state, data files, verifier, agent framework, and model are fixed while skill setup changes.
paper_run_identity.implication: The study internally had the identities needed for a task-skill-root-cause join, but internal existence is not equivalent to a released case-level truth table.

arxiv_source_release_url_audit.interpretation: The submitted arXiv source contains dependency/reference URLs but no author-declared project, code, dataset, SkillTriage, or case-level annotation release URL. This is evidence about the submitted source only, not proof that no external release can ever exist.

github_repository_api.result_semantics: Exact repository-search queries returned zero repositories at audit time. Repository search does not prove absence of matching strings inside unrelated repositories.

github_code_api.interpretation: No zero-result claim is made for GitHub code search.

skillsbench_trajectory_non_substitution.allowed_use: Original SkillsBench trajectory assets may help recover original benchmark runs only when their exact run identity is proven.
skillsbench_trajectory_non_substitution.forbidden_substitution: Do not treat the original SkillsBench trajectory repository as the harmful-paper target/reference dataset merely because both use SkillsBench tasks.
skillsbench_trajectory_non_substitution.reason: The harmful-paper study executes a new controlled OpenCode 1.15.1 plus Claude Opus 4.6 comparison space and records loaded skills per run; its paper-time task/skill/run identities must be recovered from that study or an independently equivalent truth source.

remaining_missing_public_truth: A released row-level mapping from each manually adjudicated IRF/RRO case to a stable paper-run case identity
The host-task identity for each released manually adjudicated IRF/RRO case
The loaded-skill identity for each released manually adjudicated IRF/RRO case
why_hold: The root-cause truth itself is no longer uncertain: the first-party arXiv source explicitly states that each retained case was manually inspected, assigned one root-cause label, and finalized through group consensus, and the paper fixes IRF=46 and RRO=36. The same source also states that each executed run recorded its loaded skill and trajectory. However, the submitted source does not expose a project/code/data release URL or a row-level annotation table joining those manual labels to stable paper-run task and loaded-skill identities, and exact GitHub repository searches did not locate a matching release as of 2026-08-19. The frozen C02 falsifier therefore remains blocked on public/reviewable case-level truth, not on benchmark provenance and not on whether manual labels existed internally.
reopen_only_if: Reopen when a first-party case-level release, or an independently reviewed equivalent truth source, exposes the manually adjudicated IRF/RRO labels together with stable paper-run host-task and loaded-skill identities. A future public release should trigger re-audit rather than being assumed absent permanently.
